action_descriptions.get: get a single variable or "settings" to get all variables
action_descriptions.set: set a single variable to a new value
action_descriptions.extend: add minutes of extra allowance for today (val=minutes)
action_descriptions.message: show a popup message on the PC (val=text)
action_descriptions.shutdown: shut down the PC after a warning (val=seconds, default 60)
action_descriptions.get_logs: read the agent log file (tail=N lines, default 500, max 5000)

variable_descriptions.name: read-only, name of computer
variable_descriptions.current_user: read-only, the username of the currently logged-in user
variable_descriptions.bed_time: bed time, at which the computer will be locked
variable_descriptions.manual_lock: boolean, whether a manual lock is in effect
variable_descriptions.wake_time: time, at which the computer can be used the following morning
variable_descriptions.cumulative_extension: read-only, a running total of extension seconds today
variable_descriptions.accumulated_seconds: read-only, a running total of active seconds used today
variable_descriptions.enforcement_active: read-only, whether schedule/limit enforcement is active
variable_descriptions.enforcement_reason: read-only, brief reason when enforcement is active (or null)
variable_descriptions.access_status: read-only, brief overall access status for the parent panel
